import json, math, random, sys, time
from fractions import Fraction
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor')
import controller, probability

def build_case(rng, nslots, nwindows, nflows, ngroups):
    slots=[]; t=0
    for i in range(nslots):
        slots.append([t, rng.randint(0,4), 0 if i==0 else rng.randint(0,3)]); t += rng.randint(1,20)
    groups=[]
    for g in range(ngroups):
        parent = -1 if g==0 or rng.random()<0.5 else rng.randrange(g)
        groups.append([parent, rng.randint(0,8)])
    flows=[]
    for f in range(nflows):
        target=rng.randint(1,4); ceiling=rng.randint(target, target+6)
        group=-1 if ngroups==0 or rng.random()<0.4 else rng.randrange(ngroups)
        flows.append([target,ceiling,group,rng.randint(0,6)])
    windows=[]
    for j in range(nwindows):
        ready=rng.randint(0,slots[-1][0]); expires=rng.randint(ready, slots[-1][0]+20)
        windows.append([rng.randrange(nflows),ready,expires,rng.randint(1,65535),rng.randint(1,320),
                        rng.randint(0,65535),rng.randint(1,1000),
                        [[rng.randint(0,1500),rng.randint(0,2560)] for _ in range(9)]])
    return {"model":rng.choice(['cnn','rnn']),"class_values":[rng.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(7)],
            "stats":[rng.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(3)],"bucket":[rng.randint(1,8),0],
            "slots":slots,"flows":flows,"groups":groups,"windows":windows}

rng = random.Random(4242)
mismatch = 0
for trial in range(60):
    case = build_case(rng, rng.randint(2,8), rng.randint(0,25), rng.randint(1,4), rng.randint(0,3))
    parsed = controller._parse(json.dumps({"version":3,"cases":[case]}).encode())[0]
    thr = probability.window_thresholds(parsed['stats'], parsed['windows'])
    cv = parsed['class_values']
    # use the real predictions
    import testcnnonnx, testrnnonnx
    feats=[w[7] for w in parsed['windows']]
    preds = (testcnnonnx if parsed['model']=='cnn' else testrnnonnx).evaluate_model_single_pass(feats,[0]*len(feats))
    values=[parsed['windows'][j][6]*cv[preds[j]] for j in range(len(parsed['windows']))]
    elig=[parsed['windows'][j][5]<thr[j] for j in range(len(parsed['windows']))]
    model=controller._build_arcs(parsed, values, elig)
    arcs=model['arcs']; nodes=model['nodes']
    targets=[f[0] for f in parsed['flows']]
    cands=sorted({Fraction(k,t) for t in targets for k in range(t+1)})
    feas=controller._Feasibility(model)
    lo,hi=0,len(cands)-1;best=0
    while lo<=hi:
        mid=(lo+hi)//2
        ok,_,_=feas.run([math.ceil(cands[mid]*t) for t in targets])
        if ok: best=mid; lo=mid+1
        else: hi=mid-1
    ratio=cands[best]
    lower=[math.ceil(ratio*t) for t in targets]
    feas.run(lower); ff=feas.original_flow()
    working=[(arc[0],arc[1],0,arc[3],arc[4]) for arc in arcs]
    for f in range(model['flow_count']):
        p=model['flow_arc'][f]; cur=working[p]; working[p]=(cur[0],cur[1],lower[f],cur[3],cur[4])
    base=[working[i][2]+ff[i] for i in range(len(working))]
    # cost scaling
    f2=controller._cost_scale(nodes, working, list(base))
    # cycle canceling
    circ=controller._Circulation(nodes, working); f1=list(base)
    for _ in range(20000):
        cycle,dist=circ.negative_cycle(f1)
        if cycle is None: break
        if not circ.augment(cycle,f1): break
    def objective(f):
        pairs={ (s,j): i for i,(s,j) in enumerate(model['pairs']) }
        assign={}
        for (s,j),i in pairs.items():
            if f[i]>0: assign[j]=s
        u=sum(values[j] for j in assign); a=sum(parsed['slots'][s][0]-parsed['windows'][j][1] for j,s in assign.items())
        return u,a
    o1=objective(f1); o2=objective(f2)
    if o1!=o2:
        mismatch+=1
        print('MISMATCH trial',trial,'cycle-cancel',o1,'cost-scale',o2, 'ratio',ratio)
print('compared 60 instances, mismatches:', mismatch)
